sources.title: 10Eros-Max: The New MiniMax H3 Model - kombitz.com
sources.snippet: A new experimental model called 10Eros-Max is pushing MiniMax H3 in an unusual direction. Rather than training a conventional fine-tune from scratch, the project experiments with transferring learned characteristics from other diffusion models directly into selected attention and feed-forward layers of MiniMax H3.
